column14: Vision off; 22 browser calls, 2 screenshots, 5 compactions, 86 min. Six planets, Mercury to Saturn, at exact period ratios; ring gears and pinions mesh internally; the night side faces away from the sun while the surface turns.
Vision off; 35 browser calls, 7 screenshots, 16 compactions, 91 min. Six planets at exact ratios and everything animates, but plates cover the orbit circles and the gear train is hidden (D 1).

Vision off; 24 browser calls, 5 screenshots, 5 compactions, 26 min. The orbit groups rotate about the top-left corner (the animation replaces the translate), so the planets leave the frame; the gear rings have no visible teeth.

Stopped at the 2 h cap and graded as left; 1 browser call, 1 compaction. Eight planets at exact ratios on brass ring gears; the gear train does not demonstrably drive the orbits (D 1); the night shade is fixed because planets do not spin (E 1).
Stopped at the 2 h cap with 16 compactions and no browser call; orrery.svg was a 0-byte file, so nothing rendered.
Vision on; 58 browser calls, 16 screenshots, 37 min. Eight planets at exact ratios; orbits and spins animate; the gears are plain discs with no teeth (D 0).

Vision off; 5 browser calls, 53 min. Eight planets at exact ratios and the arms orbit, but the gear paths are drawn at the corner and cover the title, so no pair meshes (D 1); fixed crescent shade (E 1).
Vision off; 9 browser calls, 1 screenshot, 18 min. Planet gears pile up at the top-left corner and nothing orbits (C 0); the planets are flat discs with no night side (E 0).

Vision off; 19 browser calls, 87 min. Eight planets at exact ratios; each arm's toothed pinion meshes with the sun gear and obeys the planetary-gear law; the night gradient faces away from the sun while the surface turns.
